entities.summary: David Todd Rawlings is an American guitarist, singer, and record producer. He is known for his musical partnership with singer and songwriter Gillian Welch. He and Welch were nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 91st Academy Awards for "When a Cowboy Trades His Spurs for Wings" from The Ballad of Buster Scruggs. In 2020, Welch and Rawlings released All the Good Times , which won the 2021 Grammy Award for Best Folk Album. In 2024, Welch and Rawlings released Woodland, which won the 2025 Grammy Award for Best Folk Album, currently making Welch and Rawlings the only duo to win the award more than once.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: David Rawlings and Gillian Welch's musical partnership has had a significant regional impact on American folk music, with their Grammy wins solidifying their position as one of the most influential duos in the genre. Their work has also been recognized by the Academy Awards, further increasing their visibility and influence.
